column1: Season the chicken with salt and pepper, sear well on both sides in a hot oiled skillet, then move to a baking dish.
Blend the chutney, cream, orange juice, butter, and curry together (an immersion blender works well). Adjust seasoning and pour over the chicken.
Bake in the middle of the oven for about 30 minutes until the chicken is cooked through.
Top with pomegranate seeds, chopped peanuts, cilantro, and sliced chili. Serve with lime, rice, and naan.
